title: The Lyon
creator: CrossFit
description: Five rounds, each for time, of 7 squat cleans, 7 shoulder-to-overhead and 7 burpee chest-to-bar pull-ups, with two minutes' rest between rounds. Honours U.S. Air Force Capt. David Lyon, killed by an IED in Kabul in 2013. Use a bar about six inches above your reach for the burpee pull-ups; record each round.
